batch: Batch 2 — Southeast Asia (TH, SG, MY, VN, ID)

defects.title: Missing Explicit Address Validation Profiles for MY, VN, ID
defects.description: jurisdiction-address-registry.ts fell back to universal baseline without explicit postal format regex for Malaysia, Vietnam, and Indonesia.
defects.remediation: Added explicit AddressProfile entries for MY (5-digit Pos Malaysia), VN (5-digit national), and ID (5-digit Pos Indonesia) with local administrative subdivisions.

defects.title: Mock Financial Adapters Lacked Southeast Asian Currency Coverage
defects.description: MockPaymentProviderAdapter and MockPayoutProviderAdapter supported only PHP, USD, EUR, failing test harness runs in THB, SGD, MYR, VND, IDR.
defects.remediation: Expanded supportedCurrencies in both test-only adapters to include THB, SGD, MYR, VND, IDR.

defects.title: Tax Registry Missing Specific Statutory References for Southeast Asia
defects.description: Tax registry used generic international baseline rather than statutory tax profiles for TH (Revenue Dept 7% VAT), SG (IRAS 9% GST), MY (Customs 8% SST), VN (GDT Circular 80), and ID (DJP PMK 60/2022).
defects.remediation: Added explicit evidence-based tax profiles with statutory citations, tax invoice field requirements, and human review items.
